name: Osmious-Playa
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed dust seas stretching to the horizon in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
The colonists of the ancient alien ruins kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
